title: Financial Evidence Fallback Across Enterprises
objective: Distinguish supplied company reports, governed report references, financial-reporting Evidence and genuine absence across all six TEL-001 Enterprises.
implementation_summary: Flora now distinguishes between a supplied company financial report, a governed report reference, governed financial-reporting Evidence, and genuine absence. Executives can therefore reach useful financial Evidence even when the underlying source report itself is not supplied, without weakening Evidence provenance or inventing reports.
expected_visible_outcomes: BT Group retains its Q1 FY27 supplied company report.
CityFibre and TalkTalk expose governed company-subject financial-reporting Evidence without presenting it as a supplied report.
Openreach and VodafoneThree retain truthful empty states; Virgin Media O2 retains its supplied report.
Advanced Inspection reconciles Financial Position and Key Reports for all six Enterprises from the canonical selector.
unchanged_areas: Protected: 308 Relationship candidates; working Enterprise identity lineage and associations; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; factual dimension isolation; candidate governance.
required_test_steps: Open Advanced Inspection and review Financial Reporting State and Financial Position → Key Reports Reconciliation for all six Enterprises.
Confirm BT Group retains its Q1 FY27 report.
Inspect Key Reports for CityFibre, Openreach, TalkTalk, Virgin Media O2 and VodafoneThree.
Confirm fallback Evidence opens through Open evidence and no unsupplied report or URL is fabricated.
Confirm no Enterprise uses another company’s financial Evidence as its own.
fresh_import_policy: NO — this is a read-only presentation and selection projection over unchanged canonical Evidence.
known_limitations: TEL-001 supplies no qualifying BT external analyst, broker, equity-research or market-research report; the runtime therefore shows a truthful empty state.
Evidence availability does not promote unextracted report content into canonical Enterprise facts.
Enterprise Economics and Leadership / Governance remain architectural intent, not independently implemented TEL-001 runtime dimensions.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in the focused evidence-utilisation, Executive Enterprise Intelligence and TEL-001 regression suites.

operator_validation_status: PASS — all six Enterprise dossier routes rendered from the unchanged TEL-001 fixture and canonical selector
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
material_runtime_components_changed: Enterprise dossier Key Reports four-state projection
